schema: Exact v3 markers, finite epoch/uptime/numeric scalars, UUID request/load/model IDs, one context/appearance; reject explicit ambiguity, unknown parent/deferred/task/cancellation/load links and changed model token. Allow right-censored known spans; no required completion event.
window: 30seconds from recorded appearance; separate30second appearance-arrival bound and20second Train readiness. Early exception is incomplete even if evidence is well formed. Same screenshot asynchronously externally polled; documented method change.
cleanup: Handlers installed before Popen; direct owned child only, no group/service kills; bounded drain and retained partials. Executor terminates app by exact owned device/bundle and verifies PID after helper exit.
limitations: No inference of rendered Scene or GPU activity from model UUID.
Load-call alone cannot identify model scene; return/ready provides explicit identity only when observed.
Task catch marker does not independently prove cancellation cause.
All source instrumentation and synchronous logging can perturb timing.
This release proposal explicitly forbids launch until root authorizes.
